## Kech (CR 3)

**XP** 800  
 NE Medium monstrous humanoid  

**Init** +6; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +11  

  

**Defense**

 **AC** 17, touch 13, flat-footed 14 (+2 Dex, +1 dodge, +4 natural)  

**hp** 55 (5d10+5)  

**Fort** +2, **Ref** +6, **Will** +5  

  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 40 ft., climb 20 ft.  

**Melee** 2 claws +7 (1d4+1 and bite +6 (1d6+1)  

**Special Attacks** rend (2 claws, 1d4+1)  

  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 13, **Dex** 15, **Con** 12, **Int** 10, **Wis** 13, **Cha** 11  

**Base Atk** +5; **CMB** +6; **CMD** 19  

**Feats** [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Improved Initiative, [Weapon Focus (claw)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md)  
*House rules: Dodge and Mobility are one feat, Dodgility; in their place: Weapon Focus (claw).*  

**Skills** Climb +17, Perception +11, Stealth +14 (+20 in forested areas), Survival +9; **Racial Modifiers** +2 Perception, +4 Stealth (+10 in forested areas)  

**Languages** Kech  

**SQ** pass without trace  

  

**Special Abilities**

 **Pass Without Trace (Ex)** A kech can move across any ground–ice, snow, mud–without leaving any footprints. Tracking a kech by nonmagical means is impossible.
